info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Status API provides real-time information regarding the status of prescriptions. This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status of their pharmacy prescriptions, facilitating better tracking and management. Common consumers include patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacy staff who need to monitor the progress of medication fulfillment. By using this API, stakeholders can enhance their operational efficiency and improve patient care.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of prescriptions in the system. Use this to check if a prescription is active, filled, or cancelled, providing real-time information about the medication management process.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of prescriptions. It should contain all necessary parameters to fetch the current status accurately.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsStatusRequest.title: Prescription Status Request Body
ListPharmacyPrescriptionsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving the status of a prescription.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message regarding the operation result.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsStatusResponse_.description: Response schema for the prescription status operation indicating the result of the GET request.
